description: Use when a task needs a small, throwaway multi-agent fan-out (a couple of parallel workers plus a review pass) in ANY project — trigger phrases "spawn a few parallel agents", "fan out", "quick worker team" — without the full /fabric-graph contract, no .agents/graph.md bootstrap, no state.json schema, no persistent files.
